about: AC-2b-D 14. header: 5.1, the 10 lines (no trailing newline; served text is the lines joined by newlines, a newline, then the body), refused naming the first input failing value_re, empty the deploy script header. pins: 4.3 from a fixed AC-2a trust manifest, current leaf first. cards and needs: 3.3. mint: 6.1 checks in order, stored the normalized deploy fields (turnHost "" means the DNS name). previews: 6.2 inside the AC-2a preview answer; previewHash = SHA-256(canonical_json(the answer without ok and previewHash)). decisions: 6.3 steps 1 to 5 and the delivered root rule (6.5, 6.7), words the first refusal or null. markers: 6.3 step 4. offered: 6.2 offered for the minting admin, fingerprint the AC-2a admin-key fingerprint. anchors: 6.7 in a dev-license program; licenses are AC-1 v2 tokens signed by the development key devPub. coturn: 5.2 step 9 peer lines in order. Times: now_ms (ms); license iat and exp are seconds.
